newsitem.title: USA: IES sees Iowa Duane Arnold nuke back Weds.
newsitem.headline: IES sees Iowa Duane Arnold nuke back Weds.

text.p: IES Utilities' 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power plant will likely enter a restart mode Tuesday and resume electricity production late Wednesday, a company spokesman said.
"It will probably be back on line late Wednesday," a company spokesman said Tuesday, adding "they found a valve which need to be disassembled and reassembled."
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) had said in its daily plant status report for Tuesday that Duane Arnold would return to service Tuesday.
The plant, located in Palo, Iowa, has remained in a hot shutdown mode since Friday, when it was taken off line for maintenance.
IES is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
